User Story

 

As a system user

I want to be able to use conditions for billing run

So that I will have possibility filter information in order to create invoices correctly

 

Acceptance criteria:

  1. Choosing conditions for the billing run is possible only when Billing Criteria is selected as 'Customers, Contracts or Points of Delivery conditions'

  2. When user chooses that options, it is possible to choose 'Application Level'

    1. Application level can be

      1. Customer

      2. Contract

      3. Point of Delivery

  3. Conditions logical operators:

    1. = equality operator. return true if condition 1 equals to condition 2. return false if condition 1 not equals conditions 2.

    2. > greater then operator. return true if condition 1 is greater than condition 2. return false if condition 1 less/equal then condition 2.

    3. < less then operator. return true if condition 1 is less then condition 2. return false if condition 1 more/equal then condition 2.

    4. <> not equality operator. return true if condition 1 not equals to condition 2. return false if condition 1 equals condition 2.

    5. in attribute. return true if condition 1 equals one of the value from list which is added in in attribute. return false if condition 1 not equals one of the value from list which is added in in attribute.

  4. should have brackets after attribute, to separate more than one value in brackets use comma.

    1. and logical operator. return true if condition 1 and condition 2 both are true. return false if condition 1 or condition 2 is false.

    2. or logical operator. return true if condition 1 or condition 2 is true. return false if condition 1 and condition 2 are false.

    3. not attribute. can be used before any condition and should have brackets after attribute. returns the opposite Boolean of condition

    4. () brackets. can be used for identification which condition should be checked firstly.

    5. Validate. validate formula format and displays error if format is wrong.

  5. Variable dropdown

    1. Single select dropdown

    2. Mandatory

    3. Values should be different in the Values dropdown according to the chosen variable

    4. Variables list:

      1. Contract

      2. Product

      3. Service

      4. Product Type

      5. Service Type

      6. Customer type

      7. Grid operator

      8. Contract type

      9. Measurement type

      10. Voltage level

      11. Purpose of consumption

      12. Interim and advanced payment

      13. Segment

      14. Customer number

  6. Values dropdown

    1. In the values dropdown values should be filtered according to the chosen variable with the following logic

      1. If Contract is selected as a variable, system should display two hardcoded values:

        1. Product Contract

        2. Service Contract

      2. If Product is selected as a variable, system should display all the products list in the dropdown with its name

        1. System shouldn’t display deleted products in the dropdown

        2. It should be possible to search products with its name

        3. Products list should be sorted with its creation date

      3. If Service is selected as a variable, system should display all the services list in the dropdown with its name

        1. System shouldn't display deleted services in the dropdown

        2. It should be possible to search services with its name

        3. Services list should be sorted with its creation date

      4. If Product Type is selected as a variable, system should display all values (active, non active) from the Product Type nomenclature

      5. If Service Type is selected as a variable, system should display all values (active, non active) from the Service Type nomenclature

      6. If Customer Type is selected as a variable, system should display two hardcoded values:

        1. Legal

        2. Private

      7. If Grid Operator is selected as a variable, system should display all values (active, non active) from the Grid Operator nomenclature

      8. If Contract Type is selected as a variable, system should display four hardcoded values:

        1. Combined

        2. Supply and balancing

        3. Supply only

        4. Without supply

      9. If Measurement Type is selected as a variable, system should display two hardcoded values:

        1. By settlement period

        2. SLP

      10. If Voltage Level is selected as a variable, system should display four hardcoded values:

        1. Low

        2. Medium

        3. Medium - direct connected

        4. High

      11. If Purpose of Consumption is selected as a variable, system should display two hardcoded values:

        1. Household

        2. Non-household

      12. If Interim and Advance Payment is selected as a variable, system should display two hardcoded values:

        1. Yes

          1. If Yes option is selected, it means that the product/service which is connected to the contract has interim and advance payment added

        2. No

          1. If No option is selected, it means that the product/service which is connected to the contract does not have interim and advance payment added

      13. If Segment is selected as a variable, system should display all values (active, non active) from the Segment nomenclature

      14. If Customer Number is selected as a variable, Values dropdown should be disabled and system shouldn't display any values in it

        1. If user selects Customer number as a variable, then in the text box should define additional details in order to start billing process correctly.

          1. For example: if there is a condition: (Customer number > 000000001)AND(Customer numbers < 000000007) < system should take all the customers with numbers in this range and start billing process for them

Application Levels for each condition:

  1. Contract

    1. hardcoded list:

      1. Product Contract

      2. Service Contract

    2. Customer - find all customers which has selected type of contract . For this customers find list of all contracts to run billing.

      1. Contact should be: active in term, active in perpetuity, terminated.

    3. Contract - Find exact contract valid versions

      1. Should search in all contract valid version and if at least one version contains - start billing for whole contract

    4. Point of delivery - not applicable

  2. Product

    1. list of products (and all product versions should be checked to find result)

    2. Customer - find all customer versions which has contract valid version with this product and run billing for all contract connected to this customers

    3. Contract - find all contract valid versions where this product is linked. (product means all product versions)

      1. Should search in all contract valid version and if at least one version contains - start billing for whole contract

    4. Point of delivery - not applicable

  3. Service

    1. list of services (and all service versions should be checked to find result)

    2. Customer - find all customer versions which has contract valid version with this service and run billing for all contract connected to this customers

    3. Contract - find all contract valid versions where this service is linked. (service means all service versions)

      1. Should search in all contract valid version and if at least one version contains - start billing for whole contract

    4. Point of delivery - not applicable

  4. Product type

    1. Customer - find all customers which has contract with product version with selected product type. Run billing for all contracts for this customers

    2. Contract - find all contract valid versions which has selected product type and run billing for this contract valid versions

      1. Should search in all contract valid version and if at least one version contains - start billing for whole contract

    3. Point of delivery -not applicable

  5. Service type

    1. Customer - find all customers which has contract with services with selected service type. Run billing for all contracts for this customers

    2. Contract - find all contract valid versions which has selected service type and run billing for this contract valid versions

      1. Should search in all contract valid version and if at least one version contains - start billing for whole contract

    3. Point of delivery - not applicable

  6. Customer type

    1. Customer - find all customer versions with selected customer type. Run billing for all contracts for this customer versions

    2. Contract - not applicable

    3. Point of Delivery - not applicable

  7. Grid operator

    1. Customer - find all customers which has active contract valid version with at least one activated POD with selected grid operator and run billing for all contracts of this customers

    2. Contract - find contract valid versions in which at least one activated POD with selected grid operator and run billing for this contract valid versions

      1. Should search in all contract valid version and if at least one version contains - start billing for whole contract

    3. Point of delivery - find all PODs with this value and create invoice only for this POD.

    4. Take all contracts with status:

      • Active

      • Active in Perpetuity

      • Terminated

  8. Contract type

    1. Applicable only for the product contracts

    2. Customer - find all customers which has product contract valid version with the selected contract type (defined in product or contract) and run billing for all contracts of this customer versions

    3. Contract - find all product contract valid versions with selected contract type (defined in product or contract) and run billing only for this contract valid versions

      1. Should search in all contract valid version and if at least one version contains - start billing for whole contract

    4. Point of delivery - not applicable

  9. Measurement type

    1. Customer - find all customer versions which has active contract valid version with at least one activated POD with selected measurement type and run billing for all contracts of this customers

    2. Contract - find contract valid versions in which at least one activated POD with selected measurement type and run billing for this contract valid versions

      1. Should search in all contract valid version and if at least one version contains - start billing for whole contract

    3. Point of delivery - find all POD versions with this value and create invoice only for this POD.

    4. Take all contracts with status:

      • Active

      • Active in Perpetuity

      • Terminated

  10. Voltage level

    1. Customer - find all customer versions which has active contract valid version with at least one activated POD with selected voltage level and run billing for all contracts of this customers

    2. Contract - find contract valid versions in which at least one activated POD with selected voltage level and run billing for this contract valid versions

      1. Should search in all contract valid version and if at least one version contains - start billing for whole contract

    3. Point of delivery - find all POD versions with this value and create invoice only for this POD.

    4. Take all contracts with status:

      • Active

      • Active in Perpetuity

      • Terminated

  11. Purpose of consumption

    1. Customer - find all customer versions which has contract valid version with at least one POD with selected Purpose of consumption and run billing for all contracts of this customers

    2. Contract - find contract valid versions in which at least one activated POD with selected Purpose of consumption and run billing for this contract valid versions

      1. Should search in all contract valid version and if at least one version contains - start billing for whole contract

    3. Point of delivery - find all POD versions with this value and create invoice only for this POD.

    4. Take all contracts with status:

      • Active

      • Active in Perpetuity

      • Terminated

  12. Interim and advance payment

    1. Customer - find all customers which has contract valid version with at least one interim and advance payments, run billing for all contract for this customer

    2. Contract - Find all contract version which interim and advance payments added, create invoice selected contract valid versions

      1. Should search in all contract valid version and if at least one version contains - start billing for whole contract

    3. Point of delivery - not applicable

  13. Segment

    1. Customer - find all customers version with this type of segment and create invoices for its all contracts

    2. Contract - not applicable

    3. Point of delivery - not applicable

  14. Customer number

    1. Customer - find all customers with added customer number and run billing for all contract for this customer

    2. Contract - not applicable

    3. Point of delivery - not applicable
